Class J2dCannonTower

java.lang.Object
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Entity
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Tower
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.towers.CannonTower
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.j2d.entities.J2dCannonTower
public class J2dCannonTower extends CannonTower
Concrete CannonTower with Java2D rendering.

Uses the tower_cannon.png sprite, falling back to a grey rectangle if the sprite cannot be loaded.

  • Method Details

    • render

      public void render()
      Description copied from class: Entity
      Draws this entity on the screen.

      This method is intentionally left abstract here so that the game-logic package stays free of visualization code. J2d subclasses (e.g. J2dEnemy) override it and use Graphics2D to draw the entity. The game package never imports any visualization library.
